notes: This contract records the promoted portable C++ TCK scenario for callback-time stability of a conveyed region designator during timestamped attribute reflection. The scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It asserts only that the receiver can query the callback-visible designator and observes the sent-time range after the publisher changes its source region. The pinned Lab assigns the stable requirement ID to §9.1.8, while issue RL-345 documents the page-225 source-backed mapping to §9.1.7; this correction is local and does not rewrite the Lab export. The isolated MinGW-installed current-package HLA_EVOKED scenario and contract CTests passed 2/2 with minimum positive lookahead. This is C++ TCK suite evidence, not provider conformance; it does not claim timestamp ordering, retraction semantics, broader DDM behavior, or Java parity.
